speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This England.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: They had it. Thou didst not swallow it. Die, and let me have the chair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am dead. The chalk comes off before I stand the rest.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You are clear. The plot has you done. Stand at the peg if you mean to stand the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will see the rest from here.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I lose a crown in the tiring-house, Will. Every day. Behind a curtain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's the law.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It's a hole.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the parting in the street holds. Thou goest off at Flint a king. Thou comest on in a London street a prisoner. Between the two, York says the whole unmaking.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Plume-pluckt Richard. He has it in a breath. I can be smaller than the breath. I do not have to love the curtain.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Was the gown right? The hem is the two fingers since Candlemas. I did not trip it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gown is exact, and thou wert still in it. On the highest line there was a grain that was not there at Easter. I am not calling it anything but a grain.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I felt it. I did not stop for it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I heard it. I am not naming it, and I am not retuning a morning to chase it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it, Augustine. In the garden thou steppedst into the shadow of the trees to overhear, as a girl in Warwickshire held she must. Hold that.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I did not come out.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: My gardener had the only laugh, and it was not the lords' room that gave it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will take the hired men. They know when a garden is a garden.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It wants a dog.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It wants nothing it has not got, Will. You have an apple and the jig. A dog is not the part that was left over.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. A dog would have told them when to breathe. I am saying it to the apple.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Over the water it is Faustus. I am staying on this bank.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Once is enough. God keep thee till the afternoon, which is a different trouble and not mine.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The grain stays where it was. I am not entering it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot stays on the peg. Nobody takes it down for a better speech.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Thou saidst a grain. I will not push the next one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A grain. Go and eat.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The laugh was the hired men's, and I am content with it.
